about: GBM Observatory Early Warning pilot — documented flood events used to verify the warning rules. Each event is the FIRST date for which a dated public source reports the river at or above the BWDB danger level in that district (quality A), or reports district flooding where the river reading is from an adjacent gauge or not stated (quality B). 'date' is therefore often later than the true crossing; lead times measured against it are upper bounds. Season coverage searched: 2016–2024. Absence of an event in a year is NOT evidence that no flood occurred — the catalogue is incomplete, so unmatched warnings are reported as an upper bound on false alarms, not as false alarms. 'until' is the last date the same source(s) document the river above danger level. Events marked audit:true were found AFTER the hindcast, by checking every unmatched warning episode on the main rivers and a systematic sample of Sunamganj episodes against dated reports; they are used only to re-classify those warning episodes, never to raise the detection rate.

audit.method: Riverine districts: every warning episode with no catalogued event was searched (district + river + month + 'danger level'). Sunamganj: systematic sample of every 6th unmatched Watch episode starting with the 3rd (6 of 37). One web search per episode, plus fetches of candidate reports. 'not found' means no dated report was found, not that no flood happened.
